svg.text: ROOMCLEANER / MOTOR STATION
Audit findings and controlled restart
Schematic reviewed against manufacturer references. Actual perfboard, motor rating, fuse sizing, and suspect components remain unverified.
BUILD DRAWING - check every connection with a meter before first power. Never plug/unplug the motor with power on.
Symbols are functional; use module pin labels, not drawing position.
WHAT IS VERIFIED / WHAT IS NOT
FINDING
DETAIL
Correct topology
12V to VMOT and buck input in parallel; 3.3V to driver VDD/RESET/SLEEP; one common ground.
Reported measurements
VDD, RESET and SLEEP each 3.3V; VMOT-to-adjacent-GND read 0V; later XIAO heated and lost USB recognition.
Diagnosis not established
No proof of short location or failed part. VMOT=0 can be missing feed, missing return, fuse, supply or probe issue.
USB correction
JP1 OPEN for USB. External diode alone does not isolate computer VBUS from all external-power conditions.
Protection limitation
DROK family lists no output overvoltage or input reverse-polarity protection. D1 is not an overvoltage clamp.
New items shown
JP1 disconnect and R2/R3/R4 = 10k resistors are proposed additions; presence in your build is not confirmed.
Vref set by D29
1.35 A: R100 -> 1.08 V, R050 -> 0.54 V (sheet 3). Read both sense resistors; confirm with the hold test.
No approved fuse value
F0=7.5A is existing stock. F1-F4 must protect branch wire/connectors; select with current and fuse-curve data.
Rev D additions
AS5600 on D4/GPIO6 (SDA) + D5/GPIO7 (SCL) at 3.3 V; Vref for 1.35 A (D29); MS jumpers must match config microsteps.
RESTART SEQUENCE - leave the suspect XIAO disconnected throughout passive checks.
1. Remove USB and 12V. Confirm capacitor voltage has fallen near 0V before resistance tests; do not short it with a tool.
2. Isolate/remove suspect XIAO and driver. Check bare wiring against sheet 3; inspect both sides for bridges and shared copper strips.
3. Check intended continuity, including both driver ground socket contacts to J1-2. Check separate power rails for unintended shorts.
4. With electronics disconnected, test supply before/after each fuse against supply negative. Test buck alone and verify 5.00V at TP2.
5. Use a current-limited lab supply for fault finding if available. A 7.5A fuse is not fast semiconductor protection or overvoltage protection.
6. Verify a known-good XIAO separately. JP1 open: add checked logic wiring/driver incrementally, powering off before every change.
7. With EN held HIGH, verify TP1/TP4 and set Vref from confirmed motor/Rsense data. Never guess based on screw direction.
8. Power off; connect checked coil pairs. Run only the short, unloaded jog and switch test. No suspended load or room operation.
